scope: Saved received-only P1B observation; tensor and CUDA gradient validation, no policy training
fixture_selection: First row whose kind is observation; exact digest and compressed file SHA256 recorded in result

network.global_map: 3x128x128 binary flags; 16/32 channel CNN to32x32, fixed AvgPool2d kernel8 to4x4, 128 features
network.local_maps: 3 shared 3x64x64 encoders, 16/32 channel CNN to16x16, fixed AvgPool2d kernel4 to4x4, 64 features per robot
network.candidates: Shared 16-to-32 MLP for eight candidate slots
network.heads: 1000-way jointly masked actor and one team value

checks: Illegal action logits are negative infinity
Every parameter has finite gradients and aggregate gradient norm is positive
Record source freeze, plan hash, fixture hash, parameter count, wall time and peak CUDA allocation
execution_gate: Root agent must append this v2 prospective plan to shared log.md, commit/push the corrected source freeze, and notify before running this script. Never overwrite v1 artifacts.
implementation_change: Fixed input geometry: 128/64 maps become 32/16 after stride-2 convolutions. Replace adaptive 4x4 pooling with disjoint AvgPool2d kernels 8/4, equal averages and gradients, preserving strict determinism.
